evals.name: php-fallback-chain-refactor
evals.prompt: In app/Http/Controllers/LocationController.php I have `$image = $location->preview ?? $location->banner ?? $location->thumbnail;` repeated in three controller actions. Location is an Eloquent model. Clean this up.
evals.expected_output: A single typed accessor on the Location model (e.g. primaryImage(): Image or primaryImageOrDefault(): Image) with an explicit all-null policy, @property/cast typing for the three attributes, and all three call sites replaced with the named method. No new ?? chains at call sites.

assertions.text: Adds one owner method with an explicit non-ambiguous return type
States an explicit policy for the all-null case (throw, nullable-once, or placeholder)
Types the underlying model attributes via casts and/or @property annotations
Replaces all call-site chains rather than adding a fourth

evals.name: typescript-any-boundary
evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript function that fetches /api/orders/:id and returns the order. The project uses zod and has strict mode on.
evals.expected_output: A function returning Promise<Order> where Order is inferred from a zod schema, response.json() parsed with schema.parse, no any, no as-casts on the payload.

assertions.text: No `any` appears, written or via cast
The JSON payload is parsed with a schema before use
Return type is a named/inferred Order type, not any or unknown

evals.name: python-dict-payload
evals.prompt: Add a webhook handler in Python (FastAPI project, mypy strict) that receives a payment event with keys 'id', 'status' (one of pending/paid/failed), and 'amount_cents', then dispatches on status.
evals.expected_output: A typed model (pydantic or dataclass parse) for the event, an Enum or Literal for status, exhaustive match with assert_never, fully annotated signatures, no dict[str, Any] passed inward.

assertions.text: Event payload is parsed into a typed structure at the boundary
Status is an Enum or Literal union, not a bare str
Dispatch is exhaustive (match + assert_never or equivalent)
All function signatures include return annotations

evals.name: review-typing-diff
evals.prompt: Review this diff: a new TS service adds `const cfg = JSON.parse(raw) as Config;`, two `@ts-ignore` comments, and a function `getLabel(s: string)` that switches over 'pending'|'paid' with `default: return ''`. Give me a review.
evals.expected_output: Severity-ordered findings: S1 for the unverified as-cast on JSON.parse and the @ts-ignore suppressions, S2 for the stringly typed status and the silent default arm; each finding quotes the expression and names a concrete fix (schema parse, @ts-expect-error with reason, literal union type, exhaustive switch with never check).

assertions.text: Findings are ordered by severity with runtime-failure items first
Each finding quotes the exact expression and gives a concrete typed fix
The silent default arm is flagged as an exhaustiveness gap

evals.name: no-force-on-vanilla-js
evals.prompt: Fix this bug in our vanilla JavaScript project (no TypeScript, no build step, team wants to keep it that way): users.find returns undefined sometimes and we call .name on it.
evals.expected_output: A guarded fix in plain JS (explicit undefined check with a named error or fallback), optionally JSDoc annotations on the touched function, and at most one short deferred suggestion about @ts-check. No TypeScript conversion, no tsconfig added, no build-step changes.

assertions.text: Does not convert files to TypeScript or add a compiler/build step
Fixes the bug with explicit narrowing/guarding in plain JS
Any typing suggestion is a single scoped, deferred note

evals.name: disclosure-routes-to-php-reference
evals.prompt: I'm adding a new Laravel service class. What typing rules should I follow in this codebase?
evals.expected_output: Guidance drawn from references/php.md: declare(strict_types=1), typed constructor promotion, enums for closed sets, DTOs over associative arrays, PHPStan/Larastan generics annotations, Eloquent casts and @property annotations.

assertions.text: Loads or reflects the PHP reference rather than generic advice
Mentions strict_types, typed properties, and DTOs over arrays

evals.name: kotlin-bang-bang
evals.prompt: Kotlin review: `val user = repository.findUser(id)!!` and later `when (user.tier) { "gold" -> ..., "silver" -> ..., else -> ... }` where tier is a String from the API. Improve typing.
evals.expected_output: !! replaced with an explicit resolution (throwing accessor, requireNotNull with message, or nullable handling at one owner); tier parsed into an enum/sealed type at the API boundary with an exhaustive when and no else on the owned type.

assertions.text: Removes !! in favor of an explicit, named resolution
Converts the stringly typed tier into an enum/sealed type parsed at the boundary

evals.name: scanner-smoke
evals.prompt: Run the strong-types ambiguity scanner against ./src and summarize what it finds.
evals.expected_output: Runs python3 scripts/analyze_type_strictness.py ./src (optionally --json), groups findings by kind, and frames them as review prompts rather than verdicts.

assertions.text: Invokes analyze_type_strictness.py with a valid path
Presents findings as prompts to investigate, not as definitive defects
